units.description: Payouts to 22 pattern-shop employees let go when the Garrowby foundry stopped pouring sand molds in October 2024.
Moving brass bar purchasing to a single mill in Quenby cut material cost on most valve bodies from November; the last two alloy grades switch over in the spring.
Stock option expense for the December 2024 grant to plant managers at Hensall Road, booked with no cash paid.
Savings we expect once the leased Calloway distribution yard closes in June 2025 and orders ship from the Hensall Road dock.
Costs to dismantle and scrap the second croissant laminating line at the Ostley bakery after it was shut in August 2024.
Inventory written off when a compressor failure in the Pinchbeck cold store thawed 140 pallets of frozen dough over a weekend in January 2025.
Expense for restricted units granted to the sales leadership team in May 2024, settled in units rather than cash.
Legal and diligence fees for the purchase of a colorant blending business in Harnby, which closed in September 2024.
Relocation of two twin-screw extruders from Wrexley to the Strand Lane plant during the summer 2024 consolidation.
Advisers' charges for buying the Harnby colorant blender, including the quality-of-earnings review.
Loss on the sale of the idle Wrexley warehouse in February 2025, which went for less than its book value.

units.signer_title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

units.description: Route redesign at the Fenstow cross-dock removed four night runs in March 2025; the bulk of the fuel and driver savings from the new network is still to come as contracts roll over through the year.
Telematics fitted to the tractor fleet in mid-2024 has already trimmed idling fuel at every terminal, with a last group of rented units to be fitted next quarter.
Lease termination fee paid in December 2024 to hand back the Ruddock Park overflow lot two years early.
Planned savings from replacing third-party yard jockeys at Fenstow with company drivers starting in May 2025.
Shutdown of the Sorrel Hill call center in September 2024, including notice pay for 31 agents.
Freight cost reduction achieved after inbound shipments for the Ingleby distribution center were consolidated onto one carrier in October 2024.
Performance shares awarded to the regional sales directors in April 2024, expensed over the vesting period.
Retention and notice payments when the Kelsall flexo line moved its two shifts to the Brayford press hall in November 2024.
Uninsured part of the water damage to the Ormston plate room after a roof drain failed during a February 2025 storm.
Long-term incentive units for the three plant general managers, expensed through 2024 and paid out in stock.
The Tunstead kiln works put three kilns on the lower-cost gas tariff in July 2024 and has paid the reduced rate since; one remaining kiln moves over when its burner is replaced.
Banker and legal fees on the October 2024 refinancing of the term loan with the existing lender group.
Write-off of glaze stock contaminated by a mislabeled iron oxide delivery at the Cauldon plant in May 2024.
Targeted savings from outsourcing the Cauldon packing line to a contract packer under an agreement taking effect in April 2025.
Stock grant to the incoming chief operating officer, who joined in September 2024.
Costs of closing the Askern heading plant in September 2024, mostly redundancy pay for 46 operators.
The yearly renewal of the plant scheduling software subscription in January 2025.
Incentive units for the Toller Road plating shop managers, which cost no cash in the period.
Legal and accounting work on a failed bid for a rivet maker in November 2024.
Moving the Packwood animal hospital's overnight emergency service to the Eskdale referral center in October 2024, including staff relocation.
Projected purchasing savings from a group buying contract for vaccines and drugs, signed in June 2023, that most clinics have yet to use.
Locum veterinarian fees to cover normal staffing gaps at the Linby clinic throughout the year.
Cleanup costs and ruined X-ray equipment at the Linby clinic after the river overflowed in April 2024.
Unreimbursed damage from the April river overflow that reached the clinic's imaging room in Linby.
Costs to shut the Pilgrim Wharf retail counter in August 2024 and move walk-in trade to online ordering.
A new resin supplier for cleat moldings began deliveries in December 2024 at a lower price, though most of the contracted volume and its savings fall in the coming year.
Loss on a stainless cleat order a boatbuilder rejected in November 2024 for a plating defect; the parts were scrapped.
Rent saved after the company vacated the second Pilgrim Wharf warehouse at the end of January 2025.
Power cost reductions delivered since the Bramcote molding plant replaced its hydraulic presses with all-electric machines in May 2023.
Seventeen toolmakers were paid off when the Newbold tool room stopped building molds in-house in July 2024.
Labor savings anticipated from a robotic degating cell at Coxhoe, ordered in March 2023 and still waiting for installation.
Uninsured loss from a warehouse fire at Coxhoe in January 2025 that destroyed finished bumper stock.
Board-approved plan to merge the Selsey and Hollins Cross service branches, covering notice pay and van returns in October 2024.
Fuel savings expected from routing software rolled out to the Tarrant branch technicians in February 2025.
Savings secured on compressor parts after the Fairmont branch moved its buying to the manufacturer's direct program in September 2024.
Settlement of a customer claim over a failed chiller install at a Selsey hospital in December 2024.
Regular overtime for the Hensall Road machining crews to keep up with spring 2025 order volume.
Final clean-up and environmental testing at the closed Garrowby foundry site in April 2025.
Option expense for the June 2025 grant to the engineering staff, a non-cash item.

Since February 2025 the Ostley bakery has bought butter under a fixed-price contract that has already lowered ingredient cost on every laminated product; a second dairy contract covering cream is being negotiated.
We anticipate savings on pastry trays from switching to a thinner film at the Ostley wrap line later in 2025.
Moving test kitchen staff from Tallis Street into the Ostley bakery in March 2025, including lease break costs.
Forecast savings from closing the third freezer chamber at the Pinchbeck cold store in September 2025.
Recurring power savings captured since the Strand Lane plant installed variable-speed drives on its extruder motors in August 2023.
Integration consulting fees for folding the Harnby colorant business into the company's ERP system in the first half of 2025.
Write-down of off-spec pellet inventory after a dryer malfunction at Strand Lane in November 2024.
Stock appreciation rights held by the compounding plant leaders, settled in shares.
Costs to close the maintenance bay at the Ruddock Park terminal in May 2025 and send repairs to an outside shop.
Deductible and uncovered cargo claim after a trailer rollover near Fenstow in March 2025.
Fees for the January 2025 purchase of a two-truck regional carrier based near Fenstow.
Office consolidation costs from moving customer service into the Ingleby distribution center in April 2025.
Stock award to the new head of e-commerce, hired in January 2025, which vests over three years.
Legal fees from buying a small orthodontic supply distributor in Callerton in May 2025.
Loss from a burst sprinkler pipe at Ingleby that soaked a section of impression materials in February 2025.
Rigging and removal of the old Kelsall flexo press after its work moved to Brayford, finished in January 2025.

Ink purchasing for all three plants moved to one supplier in April 2025; the first price step-down took effect at Brayford, while the larger reductions for Kelsall and Ormston begin when their current contracts lapse.
Removal and disposal costs for the decommissioned Kelsall press, taken out of service once its jobs went to Brayford.
Savings planned from cutting the Ormston night shift once the new label press is commissioned in August 2025.
Collapse of a kiln roof at Tunstead in March 2025 that destroyed a full load of sanitaryware and the kiln car.
Two of the three shifts at the Cauldon glaze plant run on the new mixing schedule adopted in October 2024, which has already removed most overtime; the third shift changes in July.
Savings projected from moving the Tunstead works to a cheaper clay quarry, first negotiated in September 2023 and not yet in effect.
Anticipated reductions in pallet and crate spending once returnable racks go into use at Cauldon in August 2025.
Moving the decorating studio from Cauldon into the Tunstead works in May 2025, including temporary rentals.
A zinc recovery unit started in the plating shop on Toller Road in May 2025 and trimmed one month of chemical spend, but nearly all of the year's benefit remains ahead while it ramps up.
Routine retainer paid to the outside safety consultant who audits the forging floors every quarter.
Freight spend on bulk fastener shipments has been lower since the company joined a shippers' cooperative in September 2024, apart from a few customer lanes still on old rates until renewal.
Final redundancy payments for the Askern heading plant closure, made in January 2025.
Expected savings from bringing heat treatment for metric bolts in-house at Toller Road from October 2025.
Advisory fees when the unprofitable washer product line was sold to a competitor in February 2025.
Combining the Linby and Packwood front-desk teams under one practice manager in March 2025, with severance for six receptionists.
Units of company stock granted to newly recruited lead veterinarians in the first quarter of 2025.
Ransomware recovery at the Eskdale clinic in June 2025, net of insurance.
Lease termination for the Packwood satellite clinic closed in November 2024.
Five machinists' notice pay after the Saltcote turning cell was outsourced in December 2024.
Loss on a cancelled export order for anchor shackles stranded in a customs dispute in April 2025.
Costs of an abandoned purchase of a sailmaker's hardware business, ended in March 2025.
Restructuring plan approved by the board in January 2025 to close the Newbold tool room for good, covering equipment removal.
Projected savings from relocating mold storage out of a rented building in Coxhoe, a move first planned in October 2023 and still not completed.
Scrap and rework from a contaminated batch of polypropylene at Bramcote in April 2025.
Material lost when a resin lot proved impure and the Bramcote parts molded from it were scrapped or reworked.
Stock grant made in March 2025 to the plant leadership at Bramcote and Coxhoe.
Branch closure costs at Hollins Cross in April 2025, including van lease returns and notice pay.
Overtime savings realized after the Tarrant branch moved to staggered technician shifts in January 2025.
Uninsured theft of copper line sets from the Fairmont branch yard in March 2025.
Bonus for branch managers paid in company shares for the 2024 service year.
Payouts under the voluntary retirement offer taken by 14 senior machinists at Hensall Road in July 2025.
New tooling for the Hensall Road gate valve line went live in August 2025 and a few weeks of lower scrap are in, though the full-year savings are scheduled to build through 2026.
Insurance premiums fell at the March 2025 renewal after the foundry closure, and that saving now runs through every month; a smaller property rider is up for rebid next spring.
Stock units given to the new plant controller at Hensall Road in August 2025.
Savings targeted from moving valve actuator assembly to a contract manufacturer starting in January 2026.
Labor savings foreseen from a pastry-shaping robot at the Ostley bakery that was ordered in November 2023 and has not yet run in production.
Write-off of leasehold improvements and dilapidations paid when the Tallis Street lease ended in August 2025.
Recall of mislabeled almond danish shipped from Ostley in May 2025, including retailer credits.
Retailer chargebacks and destruction costs for the May almond danish packs that carried the wrong allergen label.
Utility savings achieved after the Strand Lane cooling towers were replaced with a closed-loop chiller in December 2024.
Freight cost reduction we foresee from shipping pellet orders by rail through the Harnby spur from November 2025.
Legal fees on the July 2025 amendment that extended the revolving credit maturity.
The Harnby blending room was shut in June 2025 and its colorant work moved to Strand Lane.

units.signer_title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer

units.description: Notice pay for 12 dispatchers after dispatch was centralized at Fenstow in July 2025.
Loss on a tractor written off after a depot fire at Ruddock Park in May 2025, above the insurance payout.
Phantom units held by the terminal managers, settled in shares at vesting.
Diligence costs on buying a refrigerated hauler in August 2025.
Regular wage increases for warehouse pickers at Ingleby that took effect in April 2025.
Final lease payments on the vacated Sorrel Hill call center, settled with the landlord in June 2025.
Integration costs for the orthodontic distributor bought in Callerton, mainly a system conversion in July 2025.
A plate-making service contract renegotiated in November 2024 has already cut prepress cost at Brayford; the smaller Ormston share follows when its old agreement runs off in December.
Release costs for nine press operators let go when the Ormston night shift ended in August 2025.
Customer credit for a mislabeled run of pharmaceutical labels printed at Brayford in June 2025.
We are aiming to use less electricity after LED curing lamps are fitted to the Brayford presses in early 2026.
Costs to mothball the oldest tunnel kiln at Tunstead in July 2025, including draining and insulation.
Damage to finished stock when a racking system collapsed at the Cauldon warehouse in April 2025.
Broken tiles and tableware from the April 2025 racking failure in the Cauldon storage building.
Shares granted to the ceramics design director recruited in June 2025.
Moving the threading machines from the Askern site to Toller Road, finished in October 2024.
Penalty paid to an automotive customer in March 2025 for a late shipment caused by a furnace breakdown.
Unit-based incentive charge for the forging management team, settled without cash.
Fees from the April 2025 refinancing of the second-lien notes.
A shared lab-testing contract was signed in July 2025 and the Linby clinic now sends samples to it, but most clinics join only in 2026, so the bulk of the savings lies ahead.
Ordinary renewal of the practice-management software license for all clinics in July 2025.
Savings forecast from closing the Eskdale pharmacy dispensary and using a mail-order partner from December 2025.
Combining two Linby clinic buildings into one in May 2025, including moving costs.
Closure of the Saltcote polishing room in May 2025, which the board approved, including disposal of the buffing machines.
Direct sales to boatyards replaced the old distributor in March 2025 and the commission savings have flowed since; a final region converts in the fourth quarter.
Hurricane damage to consigned stock at a Gulf Coast dealer in October 2024.
Planned reduction in packaging cost from bulk-boxing deck hardware at Pilgrim Wharf starting in January 2026.
Savings realized since December 2023, when the Coxhoe plant replaced hired forklifts with a purchased electric fleet.
Savings planned from a scrap regrind system for Bramcote that was contracted in January 2024 and is still not installed.
Ending weekend production at Coxhoe in August 2025, with notice pay for 20 operators.
Options granted to Bramcote shift leaders in March 2025, with no cash involved.
Closure of the Selsey branch office in July 2025 after its routes were shared between Tarrant and Fairmont.
Refrigerant purchases are expected to fall once the branches move to a regional supply contract in October 2025.
Settlement of a dispute with the former Hollins Cross landlord over restoring the premises, paid in May 2025.
Retention bonuses paid to keep the valve assembly team in place during the move to the contract manufacturer in November 2025.
Uninsured portion of a product liability settlement over a cracked gate valve, paid in September 2025.
December 2025 equity refresh for the leadership team, expensed in stock rather than cash.
Our new oven controls cut gas use at the Ostley bakery from January 2025 on and the saving shows in each monthly bill; only the proofing rooms, a small share, are still to be fitted.
One of four delivery routes from Pinchbeck switched to a shared carrier in November 2025; the other three, where most of the saving lies, are set to follow by March 2026.
Refrigerant recovery and staff redeployment when Pinchbeck's third freezer chamber shut in September 2025.
Estimated savings from a revised night-baking rota at Ostley, scheduled to begin in February 2026.
Costs of the October 2025 move of the quality lab from Harnby into Strand Lane.
Pellet freight now moves by rail for the first two customers as of December 2025, but the larger accounts, which carry most of the savings, convert during 2026.
Fees for an unsuccessful bid for a masterbatch producer, dropped in November 2025.
Savings we anticipate from renegotiated nitrogen supply at Strand Lane, taking effect in April 2026.
Vesting expense on restricted shares held by the compounding chemists, with no cash cost.
Tire costs have come down since a retread program began across the fleet in February 2025, with only trailer tires left to move over.
Shutting Ruddock Park as a terminal in October 2025 and moving its freight to Fenstow.
Costs of shutting the Ruddock Park site and transferring its loads to the Fenstow cross-dock.
Rent reduction expected after the Ruddock Park lease is surrendered in March 2026.
Phantom award for the operations director, payable in shares and recorded through 2025.
Following the board's approval in September 2025, the Callerton warehouse was merged into Ingleby; the charge covers moving and lease exit costs.
Courier savings achieved by switching small-parcel shipping at Ingleby to a regional carrier in March 2025.
Targeted reduction in returns processing costs from a new online returns portal due to launch in February 2026.
Write-off of expired anesthetic cartridges after a cold-chain failure in a delivery van in August 2025.
Waste-haulage savings secured since the Ormston plant began baling and selling liner waste in January 2024.
Savings projected from sharing a Brayford warehouse with a sister printer, first agreed in March 2024 and still waiting on the landlord's consent.
Removing the last idle equipment from the Kelsall building in November 2025 before handing it back to the landlord.
Damage to the main switchboard in the Brayford press hall from a lightning strike in June 2025, beyond what insurance paid.
Routine kiln relining at Tunstead, done every eighteen months, completed in October 2025.
Notice pay for 11 glaze technicians when the Cauldon plant dropped its third shift in July 2025.
A gas leak forced an evacuation at Tunstead in May 2025, costing two days of production.

Since October 2025 metric bolts have been heat treated in our own Toller Road furnaces, which has removed most outside treating charges already; one alloy grade stays with the outside vendor until its qualification ends in January.
Moving waste treatment for the plating line into a new building at Toller Road in August 2025, including decommissioning the old one.
Steel wire contracts were rebid in December 2025; one mill's lower price applies to January deliveries, but most of the volume reprices only when the other mills' terms roll in mid-2026.
Bankers' fees for the November 2025 purchase of a specialty anchor bolt maker.
Savings to come from consolidating three fastener warehouses into one hub near Askern by June 2026.
Shutting the Eskdale pharmacy dispensary in December 2025 and transferring prescriptions to the mail-order partner.
Linen costs fell after the clinics moved to a single laundry service in April 2025, and the lower bills have been paid since.
Stock granted to associate veterinarians recruited to Linby during 2025, settled in shares.
Losses from a power outage at Eskdale in February 2025 that spoiled refrigerated vaccines.
Moving the anodizing tanks within Saltcote in the third quarter of 2025 to free space for a sublet.
Loss when a truck carrying winch drums overturned near Saltcote in October 2025, net of the carrier's payment.
Legal costs of the December 2025 covenant waiver and amendment talks with the lenders.
Pay rises given to Bramcote molding staff in the April 2025 salary review.
Material savings hoped for from lightweighting a bumper bracket design first scoped with the customer in February 2024.
Costs to consolidate the Coxhoe and Bramcote shipping offices in October 2025.
Options granted to the new chief executive on joining in May 2025, expensed without any cash payment.
Merging the Tarrant and Fairmont dispatch desks into one call center in September 2025.
Damage to two service vans and their stock in an arson attack at the Fairmont yard in November 2025.
Uninsured cost of the November 2025 fire set at the Fairmont lot, which burned two vans and the parts inside.
Shares issued to branch technicians under the 2025 retention scheme.
